correctness.rationale: Spherical order-m functions are sin^m(theta) times polynomials in cos(theta), so their Lagrange row-sum norm equals F_L(S). Every possible fixed-grid ring ordering corresponds bijectively to a saturated chain of subsets. The attached deterministic, standard-library-only verifier uses exact rational intervals for pi, sines, cosines, cardinal interpolation, and all strict comparisons; its subset-reachability cut proves the lower bound exhaustively for every L<=12. A displayed chain attains the bound at each L; for L=12 the greedy chain is strictly worse. The L=2 polar case is analytically zero. No finite experiment is claimed to prove an infinite range.
